summary: The composer and the posting pages as SwiftUI screens.

src/posting/PostingPage.jsx.note: RoutedPage's posting case: a page that needs Virga's server (needsBackend) shows NeedsBackend under its header without its access line for an account that can't schedule; Templates is TemplatesPage, keyed by the open account, with the part of the address after it. Not yet: the hub, Drafts, Scheduled, Weekly schedule, Timers, Posted and Library pages, which show their header and that they aren't in the app yet (they wait for the scheduling port).

src/posting/PostingSettingsSection.jsx.note: Whose settings (every signed-in account, and the open one even when it needs a sign-in, by accountName with its @handle) when there is more than one, then the cards over that account's PostingSettingsModel (usePostingSettings), made again for another account: New posts, and with a long session the Weekly queue, the Default timer and the Post adviser (AdviserSettingsCard); without one, NeedsBackend in their place.

src/posting/composer/Composer.jsx.note: Ported: opening from an intent (normalizeIntent, seedFromIntent, setting aside what was being written, the notices), restoring what was kept (keptPostFor, takeSetAside, openAside, elsewhereNotices), loading a reply or a quote, posting as another account (changeAsDid, gatesForAccount), the default reply settings, adding pictures (picked, pasted, an intent's described ones) and a video (uploaded as soon as it's added), quotes and link cards found in the text, splitting, renumbering and its undo, removing and adding posts, the settings row (tags, language, replies, timer, More › Continue a thread and Start over), a "/" template applied over its shortcut (applyTemplate, applyPlan: its text and what it attaches), Continue a thread (the archive's posts, else the author feed), the phone's bar at the top (Close, the title and the send button, 640 and under), the busy line, the slow and hard publish watch, publishErrorView, the posted toast and resetting after a send, the autosave (flushed on Close and when the app goes to the background). Publishing goes through ComposerPublisher (VirgaUI/Composer/ComposerServices.swift); until publish.js's port is wired, UnavailablePublisher shows the web's busy line and then says publishing isn't in the iOS app yet, and Schedule, Add to queue and Save as draft do the same. Link cards come through ComposerLinkCards, a stand-in for linkCard.js's fetchLinkCard over the session's transport. Not yet, because what they call isn't ported: scheduling and the weekly queue (WhenPicker, the queue's next slot, submitSchedule), drafts (saveDraft, loading a draft or a scheduled post, the draft media store, finishSource), the timer (LifespanEditor, getLimits, the default timer, armAfterPublish), the library's panel (LibraryDialog: a template with blanks to fill says the library isn't in the iOS app yet), Save as a template (TemplateEditor), the duplicate guard (publish.js's), drag and drop, and the posted toast's View it on Bluesky link (the shell's toasts are words only). The post adviser (ComposerController+Adviser.swift): useAdviserGate configured for the posting account while the composer is open, the check before sending (its busy line in the composer's, then Getting it ready; Keep editing, Save as draft, a fix taken checked again), Check this post among the post's tools with the month's checks, AdviserBusyLine over the post, the post held still and the send button busy while a read runs, and the adviser's sheet.

src/posting/composer/ComposerDialogs.jsx.note: ConfirmDialog, MetaDialog, GatesDialog, VideoAltDialog and ContinueThreadDialog are ported. LifespanDialog says the timer isn't in the iOS app yet (LifespanEditor.jsx isn't ported).

src/posting/composer/LanguagePicker.jsx.note: Return adds the first suggestion; a hardware keyboard's arrows don't move through them.

src/posting/composer/PostBlock.jsx.note: PostTools' library button (Quote or attach from your library) waits for the library's port; pictures and a video come from PhotosPicker.

src/posting/composer/PostEditor.jsx.note: The highlights are attributes on a UITextView's own text rather than a layer under a transparent textarea. The "/" templates come from Library.detectSlashCommand, rankTemplatesForSlash and PostTemplates.matchShortcut. Not yet: the slash list's Open the library (the library's panel isn't ported), and a hardware keyboard's arrows (and Escape) through the mention and template suggestions.

src/posting/composer/TagsField.jsx.note: Backspace in an empty field doesn't take the last tag off (SwiftUI's TextField doesn't say when it's pressed).

src/posting/library/TemplateEditor.jsx.note: The editor as a full-height sheet, its foot held under the form: the note, a seed's note, Name, Text with Insert (A blank… and the four context inserts) and its count against 300, naming a new blank in place (Add, Don’t add a blank), the hint; Questions for each blank asked (its key, Question and Example or hint side by side from 640 wide, Typed answer or Pick from a list, the choices one per line, Optional) and what fills itself; Attach (Nothing, One of your posts with the recent ones five at a time and Show more, A link with Read the link; what it attaches named, Gone, the other kind kept with Remove it); Offer it when; Group and Shortcut; Suggest it when a post mentions; the server's refusal (with Sign in again for a permission) and the fields' own; and the foot: Delete, Cancel, Save template, or Discard your changes? / Delete … for good? in its place, Escape putting a prompt away. Saved through TemplatesModel with its toasts. The editor's reads (fetchOwnPosts, hydrateEmbedViews, resolveRecordLink) are written in TemplateEditorSources over VirgaNetwork's PublicAppView until sources.js is ported. Not yet: a web page's link card (linkCard.js's fetchLinkCard, the publish domain's), so such a link says it couldn't be read; the caret (SwiftUI's text editor doesn't give it on iOS 17, so Insert and a blank go at the end of the text); the groups already used offered under Group (a datalist). A swipe down is held while there are changes.

src/posting/library/TemplateQuestions.js.note: TemplateQuestions (a field per typed question, ChoiceGroup per choice question with the arrows, Home and End and choosing again to clear an optional one, · optional, the hint and note, Answer this one first., Return going to the next unanswered question, the count of those still to answer read out), ChoiceGroup and TemplatePreview (Your post / Your reply will read, the count against 300, added words, what fills itself underlined, answers on the accent's tint, blanks to answer, the attachment's card, the notes and what stops it). The preview is the caller's, or LibraryPreview.forTemplate: previewFor for a template on its own (its words into an empty post, nothing attached), written here until library/model.js is ported. Not yet: the preview within a post under way (state, postIndex, insertion), which waits for model.js's previewFor, and templateContextFrom (the caller passes a template context).

src/posting/pages/TemplatesPage.jsx.note: The page over the account's own TemplatesModel (useTemplates) and TemplateUsage (readTemplateUsage, sortTemplatesForShelf): the permission notice with Sign in again when the sign-in can't write templates; the read-again failure over the last ones seen; the bones while the first read runs; the failure with Try again; No templates yet with New template; then the count and its line with New template, the groups (Other templates for those without one), and each row: the name as the way into the editor with its /shortcut, Use and the ⋯ (Edit, Delete with its dialog and toast) on the name's line, the words with each blank marked (named as it is asked, or as it fills itself; No text: it only attaches something), and the facts (who it's for, the questions, what it attaches, the words that suggest it, how often it was used here). The editor is TemplateEditor. Use opens the composer (ComposerHost) with the template's intent; the composer reads the template once library/model.js is ported. iOS additions: /posting/templates/new and /posting/templates/<rkey> open the editor. A blank's chip is drawn on a tint in the run of words; the focus after a delete is the system's.

src/posting/pages/hubParts.jsx.note: RowSkeleton, LoadError and ConfirmDialog (busy, and a refusal's message kept in the dialog). The rest (the post rows, the posting nav, the long-session notice) come with the pages that use them.

src/posting/pages/scheduleParts.jsx.note: TimezoneSelect (TimezonePicker: this device's zone first, then the rest, an unknown stored zone kept) and SwitchButton (SettingsSwitch), as Settings › Posting uses them. The rest comes with the scheduling pages.

src/posting/ui/AdviserBusy.jsx.note: Reading your draft with readExpectation's line (slower than usual after SLOW_READ_AFTER_MS), the bar, the goals it is checking, and Keep editing and Publish anyway (the gate's) as small buttons, equal shares on a phone; read out as it appears. Brought into view by the composer rather than scrolled to.

src/posting/ui/AdviserSettings.jsx.note: Post adviser in Settings › Posting, over the account's PostingSettingsModel: NeedsBackend for an account that can't use AI; Use the post adviser (nextPostingAdviserState, the recommended setup the first time), Check before posting, Stop me, Which posts, Read replies with their conversation, Your goals (the two presets, Post less about some topics with its topics, Goals in your own words with its count), Proofread (the three checks, Notes for the proofread, Your writing style with Learn my style or See or change it, which opens StyleDialog), the month's three usage lines, What’s sent, and to whom, and a refused change's message. Which posts is a column of check boxes acting as radios.

src/posting/ui/AdviserSheet.jsx.note: The sheet over AdviserGateModel's read (sheetActions, sheetTitle, sheetContextLine, adviserSheetModel, adviserWritingTally, adviserDraftLabel): the notices (error, limit, empty, needsText), the verdict, the marked post (each post's index, a fix struck through with its replacement, a link in the words that takes it, the replacement underlined in the ok colour once taken, a flagged passage underlined in its tone with its numbers raised), the tally with Fix all, the notes (a numbered note lights its passage for a moment; others with their tone's glyph), Fine against, the context line, the usage line, the skeleton while busy, and its foot (Keep editing, Save as draft, Publish or Publish anyway, or Close). A numbered note lights its passage instead of scrolling to it.

src/posting/ui/AltTextDialog.jsx.note: With a requester that can use AI (the posting account's backendFor, canUseAi), AltTextDialog: the image, What kind of image is it? (optional) and Describe it for me before a first description, the description with its count (altTextCount, · too long), Undo of the last answer, the busy line (Describing the image…, revisingLine…), the monthly limit and the failures, Revise it (rankQuickNotes' notes, It’s a…, the note, Revise), the usage line and what describing sends, and Cancel and Save (⌘↩). Over AIService.generateAltTextForFile with the composer's prepared file, AltTextModel and AltTextFollowUp. Without a requester, the composer's own DescribeDialog (the writer's part).

src/posting/ui/ComposerDefaults.jsx.note: New posts: Languages (the composer's LanguagePicker, which names itself above its tokens), Who can reply and quote (My Bluesky setting or Choose here, with the composer's GatesEditor over the stored gates), Main button (PublishActions' four, normalized), Require alt text, Offer to split long posts and Number the posts of a split thread as switches, each saved as it changes, with a refused change's message under them.

src/posting/ui/LifespanDefaults.jsx.note: Default timer: Start new posts with a timer (its hint when off), the rule's editor (LifespanRuleEditor, a length and never a set time, its changes keeping the timer on or off as it is) under the row when on and behind The rule it will use: … when off, saved never pinned to a time, the refusal, and the caption with See posts on a timer. Not yet: the timers in use (scheduleService.js's getLimits and timerLimitsLine), so the caption starts at its second sentence as the web's does when the limits can't be read.

src/posting/ui/LifespanEditor.jsx.note: LifespanRuleEditor over LifespanModel and SelfDestruct: the switch with its line (showToggle), Delete it after or Act on it after (the five shown lengths, Other… with Length and Unit and its hint, and Or a set time on the system's date and time picker within pinBounds, with Clear), What happens then (the effects, Limit replies closed to a reply), Who can still reply (Nobody, the three groups, the writer's curation lists read through PublicAppView, and the most Bluesky takes), Conditions (optional) with Unless or Only if it reaches, a row per condition (what it counts, how it compares, how many, Remove) and Add a condition, Count quotes from, When there’s more than one, If it does or doesn’t (keep, or another window with At most), the rule in a sentence (editorNotes' summary, This post gets no timer. or No timer.) and its notes. The time is read again every thirty seconds. A row added or removed leaves the focus where the system puts it.

src/posting/ui/NeedsBackend.jsx.note: BackendAccess's four cases: nothing when ready or for no account; The long session has ended with Sign back in; Needs a long session with Reconnect for a longer session (AccountActions.lengthen), or with the line that this copy offers none. Its server glyph goes on a phone, as the web's does.

src/posting/ui/PostPreview.jsx.note: PostPreviewCard over VirgaPosting's postPreviewModel: who wrote it (the picture, the name, the handle), when (relative, the date on the pointer's tip), its words or No text, what's attached, the counts (replies, reposts, quotes, likes) and the way to it on Bluesky, and the compact form; a hairline round it. The composer's own ComposerPostPreview (EmbedCards.swift) is the compact form it draws for what a post replies to or quotes.

src/posting/ui/PostingHeader.jsx.note: PostingHeader.model and .header: Posting in the crumbs (except on the overview) or the caller's own, the page's title and line or the caller's, what it touches or not (showAccess, false where NeedsBackend stands in for the page), and the caller's actions and what goes under the header (children), drawn only when given.

src/posting/ui/QueueSettings.jsx.note: Weekly queue: the posting times a week with the week in a line and Edit the week (to Posting › Weekly schedule), the time zone (this device's first, then every zone the device knows) with the device's zone named when it differs, and Suggest posting times. scheduleModel.js's weeklyCount, weekSummary, slotLabel, zoneLabel and moveToZone are written beside it (ScheduleWords) until the scheduling pages' model is ported; TimeZone.knownTimeZoneIdentifiers stands in for Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone').

src/posting/ui/SettingsParts.jsx.note: SettingsCard and SettingsRow are Settings' own SettingsSectionView and SettingsRow (a block row's control on a line of its own; a short control kept on the label's line on a phone).

src/posting/ui/StyleDialog.jsx.note: A full-height sheet with one StyleSession per opening over the account's requester: NeedsBackend without AI, the intro, how many posts to read and Read my posts, the three stages with the posts gathered, the failure (a warning for the monthly limit), How you write (editable) with its line and · not kept yet, What should change?, Refine with my note, Read my posts again with the count, the usage line, and Forget my style, Close or Cancel, Keep this (styleProfileFrom, forgetStyleProfile), a refused save's message.
